build_DMEstimator: build a Direct Method estimator to evaluate target policy rewards using a trained reward model
build_IPSEstimator: build an Inverse Propensity Scoring estimator to evaluate off-policy rewards using importance weights
build_DoublyRobustEstimator: build a Doubly Robust estimator combining direct method and IPS for policy evaluation
build_SwitchEstimator: build a Switch estimator that adaptively selects between IPS and DM based on variance-bias tradeoff
build_SwitchDREstimator: build a Switch DR estimator that combines doubly robust estimation with adaptive threshold switching
